title: Palindrome
description:
A palindrome reads the same in both directions: "level", "racecar".

Write `bool isPalindrome(std::string_view text)` recursively:

- A text of 0 or 1 characters is a palindrome (base case).
- Otherwise the first and last characters must match, **and** the text between them must be a palindrome (recursive case).

`text.substr(1, text.length() - 2)` is the text with both ends removed.
hints: Base case: a length of 0 or 1 is a palindrome. Then compare `text.front()` and `text.back()`; if they differ, it is not one.
Otherwise the answer is the answer for the middle: `isPalindrome(text.substr(1, text.length() - 2))`.
